sections.content: The canonical package defines a read-only exact-cover conformance capability with deterministic validation, source identity binding, bounded recovery context, and a separation between semantic work and lifecycle control.
sections.title: Scope

sections.content: The implementation contract sequences typed package selection, source freezing, exact-cover validation, semantic handoff and repair, retry and shard handling, recovery context, preflight checks, and terminal dogfood validation. Protected runtime, sandbox, and live-log paths are excluded.
sections.title: Requirements

sections.content: All listed inputs have complete accepted coverage. Repository rules require fail-closed handling for invalid or stale evidence, compatibility preservation, contract-specific validation, and recorded evidence. The manifest and requirements state that the exact-cover surface remains non-authorizing.
